newsitem.title: CHINA: China's jet maker sees 500 mln yuan civil turnover.
newsitem.headline: China's jet maker sees 500 mln yuan civil turnover.

text.p: China's largest fighter jet maker, Shenyang Aircraft Industrial (Group) Company, is expected to produce civilian products worth 500 million yuan ($60.2 million) in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Civilian products make up half the company's total annual output, Xinhua quoted a company official as saying.
The company, the first to make jet planes and ground-to-air missiles in China, had developed 200 types of civilian products since shifting away from military products, it said.
It also produces civilian plane parts for 10 aircraft companies in seven countries and makes about $3 million a year, Xinhua said.

The company has a plant which produces 2,000 coaches annually, a plant that assembles 5,000 cross-country vehicles and another that makes aluminium products, the agency said. It gave no further details.
